The word "nutrient" is mentioned two or more times in 0.0% of psychology papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "nutrient" , 34.3% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a far higher rate than the median Psychology paper (median shown for reference); relative to other words, papers with "nutrient" are in the top 98th percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better). Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "nutrient" tend to be published in higher impact factor journals (84th percentile among all words) and tend to be cited more (73rd percentile word).
